title: The Gravel Bike Everyone Is Sleeping On… WINSPACE G5

takeaways.text: The size-L complete bike with SRAM Rival AXS XPLR 1×13, D45 Grier 2.0 wheels and 40 mm tires weighed 8.88 kg with pedals and the included frame bag, without cages, power meter or out-front mount.
Repeats Winspace's 58 mm front and 53 mm rear tire clearance and a 50–52T 1× chainring limit; the presenter planned but did not show a test with 29×2.35 in tires.
Quoted in September 2026 as US$5,200 for the Rival XPLR complete bike, or US$5,400 with the upgraded Grier 2.0 wheels, delivered to the door; a GRX version is also offered.

Stock Michelin Power 40 mm tires came with inner tubes; the D45 rims are hooked with about 32 mm internal width. The rear caliper adapter arrived set for 140 mm while a 160 mm rotor was fitted, which the presenter wished had been labelled.
Uses a proprietary seatpost with a rubber seal cover, FIDLOCK-latched down-tube storage with an included bag, and T47 outboard bearings.

disclosure: The description links to Winspace's G5 shop page and provides a GC Performance discount code; product-supply terms are not established there.
summary: Overview of a Winspace G5 complete bike linked to the G5 Ultra AXS shop listing. This is visual platform context, not confirmation of the catalog frameset build or current China price.
